entries.title: Moûsa, explained to the jury: Claude Code
entries.summary: The page that explains Moûsa, designed by Moûsa for its audience: the jury, described to Qloo by works the judges are known for. One sealed guess, two arms, the same facts, through genre conventions and a critique of the generic.

entries.title: Moûsa, explained to the jury, first build: Claude Code
entries.summary: The same page built on 23 October, before Moûsa ranked qualities by how distinctive they are and checked the looks models default to. Its Qloo arm carried seven of those habits: kept as the before.

entries.title: The Lamplight, a live music venue, with Qloo and without: Claude Code
entries.summary: An autumn season page for people who love Khruangbin, Anderson .Paak and Tame Impala, built twice from one sealed guess.

entries.title: Second Drink, a stand-up night, with Qloo and without: Claude Code
entries.summary: A weekly comedy night for people who love The Original Kings of Comedy, Def Comedy Jam and The Bernie Mac Show, built twice from one sealed guess.

entries.title: Thistledown, an RPG from one sentence, with Qloo and without: Claude Code
entries.summary: A small browser RPG for people who love Stardew Valley, built twice from one sealed guess. The guess made farming, fishing and friendship; the measurement made herding, tape-recorded interviews and a garage-band rehearsal.

entries.title: Second Drink, a stand-up night: Codex
entries.summary: The comedy night in one Codex session with Qloo: soul-sleeve conventions, and a critique of its three most generic choices.

entries.title: Ilo, with Qloo and without: Claude Code
entries.summary: One frozen prediction and two arms, built at the same time by two subagents. With Qloo, the lamplighter became a grown person holding a rose-gold cup-lamp close; without it, a masked wanderer with an amber lantern on a pole.

entries.title: Ilo, with Qloo and without: Codex
entries.summary: The same game and brief in Codex, one arm after the other in one session: the baseline was built before any Qloo data was seen.

entries.title: Ilo with title-card portraits: Codex
entries.summary: The comparison again, with Codex's own image tool allowed: each arm painted a portrait for its title card from Moûsa's brief, and Moûsa checked each against the arm's palette.

entries.title: Wax & Wane, a record shop: Claude Code
entries.summary: A website from an empty folder for an audience that loves Paterson and Nujabes.

entries.title: Wax & Wane, a record shop: Codex
entries.summary: The same request in Codex, from an empty folder.

entries.title: Ramble, a walking app, restyled: Claude Code
entries.summary: An existing app restyled through its own design tokens, with its walks and its data kept as they were.

entries.title: Lanterna, a Tailwind cinema site, restyled: Codex
entries.summary: A Vite and Tailwind CSS 4 site restyled through its theme and its own classes, then built with its own build.
